title: SHEET and SHEETS return #N/A for invalid non-error arguments and evaluate to #NAME? in compatibility version 1
statement: In Excel 16.0.20430 and 16.0.20527, SHEET([value]) accepts a reference or sheet-name string and returns its 1-based workbook sheet index (defaulting to the caller's sheet when omitted), returning #N/A for numbers, logicals, arrays, or unknown sheet names. SHEETS([reference]) counts distinct sheets spanned by a 3-D reference (or total workbook sheets including hidden sheets when omitted) and returns #N/A for any non-reference non-error value. Both require _xlfn. and evaluate to #NAME? in compatibility version 1.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in prefix_metadata (rows 318-319) and f2_rows (row 164) plus Excel 16.0.20430 controls, and matched across 3,093/3,093 SHEET and 3,107/3,107 SHEETS full-bank rows.
